items.title: H-bond as subset

provenance.discriminates: A response giving only kJ/mol values (~20 kJ/mol) without ever stating 0.5 eV.

validation.gold_why: States strength of 0.5 eV.

items.title: H-bond mechanism

provenance.calibration_rationale: Directly answers the mechanism sub-question; specific and load-bearing.

items.title: H-bond network in water

items.title: Ice density anomaly

items.title: H-bond directionality

items.title: Ratio-plot method
items.description: The response uses the ratio-plot method, letting X represent MnO4^- and Y represent Cr2O7^2-, dividing each wavelength equation by A_Sx (the Mn standard absorbance A_Mn) and regressing A_mix/A_Sx versus A_sy/A_Sx.

provenance.evidence_detail: All rollouts used direct OLS on raw absorbances instead of the ratio-transform; reference requires the ratio-plot.
provenance.discriminates: Response that applies ordinary least squares to raw absorbances A_Mn and A_Cr, yielding r_Mn ≈ 0.8356 instead of 0.8147.
provenance.calibration_rationale: Caught 3/3 negatives; core method without which no result is valid.

validation.gold_why: Uses ratio-plot method dividing by A_Sx and regressing ratio plot.

validation.gold_why: Explicitly places A_mix/A_Sx on y-axis and A_sy/A_Sx on x-axis.

items.title: Regression equation stated

provenance.evidence_detail: Reference provides this exact regression model.
provenance.discriminates: Response that never writes the fitted linear equation relating the two ratios.
provenance.calibration_rationale: Caught 3/3 negatives; central intermediate result anchoring both concentrations.

validation.gold_why: States regression equation with intercept and slope.

items.title: Intercept value 0.8147
items.description: The fitted straight-line regression has a y-intercept of 0.8147 (within rounding, e.g. 0.814–0.816).

provenance.evidence_detail: Reference gives intercept 0.8147; all rollouts obtained 0.8356 via raw OLS.
provenance.discriminates: Response reporting intercept or Mn ratio ≈ 0.8356 from unweighted OLS on raw absorbances.
provenance.calibration_rationale: Caught 3/3 negatives; specific numeric check overlapping with equation item.

validation.gold_why: Intercept 0.8147 stated exactly.

items.title: Slope value 1.7839

items.title: Average atomic mass
items.description: States the average atomic mass of a bromine atom as 79.903 u.

provenance.discriminates: A response that reports 79.895 u (from unnormalized average) or 79.917 u (from unweighted arithmetic mean of isotope masses).

items.title: Correct isotope masses
